title: Who can never be the maximum?
hook: Some candidates become useless before they leave the window.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Discard dominated candidates in a monotone deque while expiring old indices.

misconception: A previous maximum remains useful until it leaves the window.
objective: Discard dominated candidates in a monotone deque while expiring old indices.

claims.text: A newer value at least as large dominates an older candidate: it will remain available longer and can always replace it. Expiration removes indices outside the live window; dominance removes candidates that can never win.
